verdict.rationale: Bento documents out-of-the-box views of cost per run, tool failure rates, drift and regressions, and a CLI that can pull analytics. Nothing in the evidence shows the product letting a user build custom dashboards, or covering latency and eval-score metrics in a user-configurable view. Built-in metric views and exportable analytics are adjacent features, not the custom-dashboard capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can build custom dashboards over latency, error, cost, and eval-score metrics

citations.quote: you see cost per run, tool failure rates, drift over prompt versions, and regressions across deploys out of the box.
Anything you can do in the dashboard, you can do from your terminal, a script, or CI: triage issues, read runs, inspect signals, pull analytics.
